blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, Zambales — After nearly two months of suspension, face-to-face classes have resumed at a school in the Zambales town of San Marcelino following severe flooding and lahar that damaged parts of the school during the height of the southwest monsoon. Sta. Fe National High School was among the facilities in Barangay Sta. Fe damaged by heavy rains and flooding, with lahar and debris covering portions of the campus.
